scenario.name: B_rv1
scenario.description: Truth S301B (z-mirror of A), S301 RV 1 km/s from 2030.

S301B.source: arXiv:2607.12664 Extended Data Table 2, second value/error pair (= solution B). Main text p.6 quotes e = 0.9821 for B; the table gives 0.9824 (table value used).
S301B.mirror_note: Solution B is essentially the z-mirror of A: Omega_B - Omega_A = 183.1 deg and omega_B - omega_A = -178.3 deg (both ~180 deg), with i, e, a, t_p equal within errors. (Omega, omega) -> (Omega + 180, omega + 180) leaves the sky-projected Keplerian orbit unchanged and flips the line-of-sight coordinate z -> -z, hence the sign of the radial velocity. Astrometry alone cannot separate A and B (chi2 25.86 vs 25.53); radial velocities break the degeneracy (Romer delay could in principle but does not yet). Spin effects (Lense-Thirring) are not mirror symmetric either unless the spin is mirrored too.
